recentItems.title: Would Declan dye his hair red? 😂 Rice answers questions from Arsenal in the Community
recentItems.description:
We invited a group of young people from Arsenal in the Community up to Sobha Realty Training Centre to question Declan on any topic they liked - and nothing was off limits. 

During the back and forth, Declan was probed on a range of subjects - including which of his teammates would make the worst manager whether he condones pineapple on pizza, and if he'd commit to dying his hair red in the event of another title-winning season. 

To round-off the day, Declan surprised his young interviewers with tickets to Sunday‘s game. As part of our commitment to ensuring men’s matches remain accessible for our local community, we're making 1,000 tickets available free of charge across the 2026/27 season. 

This initiative, successfully launched last season, forms part of our ongoing drive to ensure our men’s matches are accessible for all members of the Arsenal family, including our young, senior and disabled supporters.
